editorial.blurb: Handlebar is a vibrant vegan and vegetarian restaurant serving creative pub fare with southwest flair, where nearly everything on the menu comes plant-based by default.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early on weekends or use their app-based waitlist system to check your spot in line—Saturday crowds draw 20-30 minute waits, but the Nashville Hot Fried Chicken and fried avocado tacos are worth it.
